يتراءيا (form VI)
# يَتَرَاءَيَا (yatarāʔayā) /ja.ta.raː.ʔa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# يُتَرَاءَيَا (yutarāʔayā) /ju.ta.raː.ʔa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
